title: SonicWall Issues Fixes for SSL-VPN MFA Bypass Flaw
excerpt: SonicWall addresses seven security vulnerabilities in SonicOS firewalls, including an actively exploited SSL-VPN authentication bypass defect.
body_html:
SonicWall has rolled out security updates to address seven distinct vulnerabilities impacting SonicOS firewalls. Among the patched issues is an SSL-VPN authentication bypass flaw that the company confirmed is currently being exploited in live attacks.

The manufacturer urges administrators to apply the provided software updates promptly to secure their environments against potential unauthorized access attempts targeting the identified weaknesses.
